pr_title: Fix enum labels to accepts as keyword arguments
pr_body:
Enum accepts labels as keyword arguments is originally intended in #41328, so I documented and covered by test that.

https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/0618d2d84a501aea93c898aec504ff9a0e09d6f2/activerecord/lib/active_record/enum.rb#L60-L65 https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/0618d2d84a501aea93c898aec504ff9a0e09d6f2/activerecord/test/cases/enum_test.rb#L702-L713

I'm not against dropping that support to simplify codebase, at least we should deprecation that before removing.

Fixes #53407.

issue_context.title: Defining `enum` with value is a keyword argument doesn't work with Rails 8.0.0.rc1
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce

Until Rails 7.2, we can define `enum` with value is a keyword argument like the following script. 

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/inline"

gemfile(true) do
  source "https://rubygems.org"

  gem "rails", "7.2.1"
  # gem "rails", "8.0.0.rc1"
  gem "sqlite3"
end

require "active_record"
require "minitest/autorun"
require "logger"

ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3", database: ":memory:")
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :posts, force: true do |t|
    t.integer :status
  end
end

class Post < ActiveRecord::Base
  enum :status, active: 0, archived: 1
end

class BugTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  def test_association_stuff
    assert_nothing_raised do
      Post.create!
    end
  end
end
```

This is documented behavior. 
https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/546ca81125749e43e30de20684913a8385deafb9/activerecord/lib/active_record/enum.rb#L63-L72 

I know defining enums with keywords args was deprecated in Rails 7.2, but that deprecation didn't cover that case. 
So in the above example, the deprecation warning isn't shown.

Related with #50987, b9226a68bb18283f9f80e73c4bfa77f2a5309740

### Expected behavior
It works or shows a deprecated message.

### Actual behavior

`ArgumentError`( `enum': wrong number of arguments (given 1, expected 2) 


### System configuration

**Rails version**:

8.0.0.rc1

**Ruby version**:

3.3.5

review_comments:
Do you think another test case for this case is worth it?
```ruby
enum :status, { default: 0, scopes: 1, prefix: 2, suffix: 3 }, prefix: true, suffix: true
```
@kamipo

Originally this did test that if single keyword arguments is recognized as label values not options since label values are required arguments.

It works fine when two label values and keyword arguments are passed, but if users are unsure whether we can use a label with the same name as an option at the same time, I'll add an extra test. fe0fb9fdf04f638996e785d3e291f5fe8bc138a0
